Name: Tree Tweaks
Author: nomisupernovahkiin
Description:
[size=3]Have you ever thought "Wow, I love Eemie's Map Recolour, but the bushes are just too bright! They weren't able to cover the new fruit trees introduced in 1.5 and I need some more desaturation to my Stardew Valley savefile!"? [/size]

Then look no further than Tree Tweaks! Designed to be compatible with Eemie's Map Recolour, but it's perfectly fine on it's own. It's a slight desaturation of the blinding bright hyper-saturated look of the vanilla trees on the map. Covers trees and bushes outside of what the player can chop down as well. If there's any trees that I've missed, please let me know so I can add them as well. :)
